document.abstract: The membership of the Society of Motion Picture Engineers grew during 1945 from 1676 to 1966. This increase is consistent with the trend during the war years. While it is a healthy, normal growth, the Committee feels that in 1946 it could be materially accelerated. To a large extent the new members acquired during the last several years have consisted of men in the Armed Forces engaged in motion picture activities. However, it is obvious that there are still many competent engineers and scientists working in our industry who are not members and who undoubtedly would like to become members if they knew the requirements of admission.
